main.description: Begin an OAuth authorization-code flow so the caller can connect their own credential to an org-configured MCP server. Returns a URL to redirect the caller's browser to; the gateway completes the flow when the authorization server redirects back to it. Requires service-auth. Callable by any org member.

org.description: DID of the community the server belongs to.

redirectUri.description: Where to send the caller's browser back to once authorization completes. Must be an HTTPS URL (or a loopback address, for local development).

authorizationUrl.description: The URL to redirect the caller's browser to in order to authorize.
